ranked.headline: Relatedness-aware and multi-ancestry QTL models link variants to gene-level targets
ranked.summary: Expanding diverse-population sampling and xQTL integration is sharpening how variants translate into candidate genes for disease and drug targeting.

ranked.headline: Testing and error control in differential expression across transcriptomic assays
ranked.summary: Spatial, long-read, and single-cell transcriptomics increasingly require explicit false-positive control and quantified batch evaluation.

ranked.headline: Scalable inference from pooled, noisy, and incomplete genomic data with EM and ML
ranked.summary: Pooled and high-dimensional sequencing datasets now demand inference methods that scale while recovering missing or ambiguous information.

ranked.headline: ML and sequence-based tools predict pathogen resistance from reads and spectra
ranked.summary: Nanopore and metagenomic read pipelines now return resistance calls from raw reads, some within 30 minutes.

ranked.headline: Learned protein and ligand representations drive binding and design prediction
ranked.summary: Large DEL screens, ESM-2 and ProstT5 embeddings, and E(3)-equivariant features now support binding prediction and peptide design across targets.

ranked.headline: Noncoding variants mapped to target genes via splicing, polyadenylation and 3D contacts
ranked.summary: Noncoding GWAS variants in Alzheimer's and bone density are now being tied to target genes through CRISPRi, Hi-C and allele-specific assays.

ranked.headline: Multimodal learning models predict drug combinations, interactions, targets and synergy
ranked.summary: Recent items fuse heterogeneous drug, cell-line, and molecular modalities into graph, pretrained-encoder, and tensor-based architectures for prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Software integrates diverse biological resources to prioritize genes and metabolites
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend gene prioritization to LLM literature mining and enrichment interpretation, without described experimental validation.

ranked.headline: Reference-free error estimation and improved variant calling from sequencing reads
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply alignment-free sketches, move-table dwelling times, window-based phasing, and LoRA-tuned foundation models directly to sequencing reads.

ranked.headline: Alignments, motifs and RNA folding models recover structural and functional information
ranked.summary: Coevolution inference, alignment diversity and suboptimal-alignment tools are being refined to extract structure from sequence data.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models resolve spatial transcriptomic domains, cell types and expression
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply flow matching, latent diffusion and contrastive graph learning to sparse and multiplexed spatial transcriptomic data.

ranked.headline: Machine learning and docking prioritize compounds and proteins for experimental testing
ranked.summary: Computational models now prioritize or design candidate molecules and proteins for direct experimental validation across multiple targets.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks expose metric and transfer failures in biological response prediction
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks question common metrics and transfer strategies for predicting biological responses from cell and perturbation data.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory states from sequence, expression and cell-free DNA proxies
ranked.summary: Standard-depth cfDNA sequencing, somatic mutation catalogs and bulk expression data are now mined to infer regulatory states without direct assays.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link coupled components to multistability and tissue-scale patterning
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add host-circuit coupling and planar polarity robustness to system-level models of tissue and gene network behavior.

ranked.headline: Biologically constrained models attribute cortical phenomena to specific components
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications attribute V1 contextual modulation, representational drift, and invariant object learning to individual model components.

ranked.headline: Boolean trap spaces and kinetic models link biomarkers to cell-state transitions
ranked.summary: Formal dynamical frameworks are being applied to biomarker-phenotype links, nociceptive PKA signaling, and cancer cell-fate transitions.

ranked.headline: Learned biological embeddings are being reused and benchmarked against simple baselines
ranked.summary: Single-cell and protein foundation models are being scrutinized against parameter-free baselines and tested for transfer across biological contexts.

ranked.headline: Energy budgets and metabolic costs shape neural coding and synaptic precision
ranked.summary: Energy and metabolic constraints are being formalized as explicit objectives in generative and synaptic models of neural activity.

ranked.headline: Learned and distance-based models infer mtDNA trees, recent Ne, and ancestry graphs
ranked.summary: Three new preprints extend learned and robust distance-based methods to mtDNA phylogeny, recent population size, and recombination-aware ancestry inference.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models encode biomolecular structure in architecture and representation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend deep learning to genomic foundation models, protein circuit tracing, RNA structure, and enzyme turnover prediction.

ranked.headline: Peptide behavior and missingness modeling precede inference in proteomics tools
ranked.summary: February 2026 work extends peptide-level modeling and missingness handling across DIA and label-free proteomics workflows.

ranked.headline: Microbiome and viral sequencing tools add reproducible, benchmarked analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Recent releases pair microbial sequence analysis tools with benchmarking, curated databases, or reproducible implementations.

ranked.headline: MD and QM/MM simulations assign function to transient biomolecular intermediates
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and QM/MM simulations now resolve free-energy landscapes of LNP, PNPLA, and PET hydrolase intermediates.

ranked.headline: Supervised models infer hidden states from routine molecular and imaging data
ranked.summary: Routine NMR metabolomics and multimodal clinical-imaging data are now paired with supervised models that carry external validation or interpretability analyses.

ranked.headline: Single-cell atlases map aging states in hematopoiesis and immune variation
ranked.summary: Large single-cell datasets now enable aging clocks, lineage reconstruction, and population-scale immune variation analysis in blood and marrow.

ranked.headline: Computational tools recovering cell-level dynamics in imaging and deforming tissues
ranked.summary: Recent tools automate tracking of cell boundaries, filopodia, and neurons in deforming live-imaging datasets, enabling quantitative analysis of dynamic…

ranked.headline: Locally deployed toolkits structure omics and metadata into queryable databases
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications describe locally deployable tools that structure plant, bacterial, and metagenomic omics data into queryable databases.

ranked.headline: Faster optimal alignment and phylogenetic placement algorithms for sequence analysis
ranked.summary: Sequence analysis tools are being redesigned for speed at pangenome and phylogenetic scale while retaining optimality guarantees.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomes link lineage-specific gene evolution to methylation and ecology
ranked.summary: Recent chromosome-level assemblies enable direct tests of lineage-specific gene evolution across myxozoans, Hydra, ants and turtles.

ranked.headline: Computational screens nominate aging and Long COVID targets from omics and networks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers apply causal genetics, single-cell transcriptomics, and network walks to prioritize aging and Long COVID targets.

ranked.headline: Graph and language models are being benchmarked against drug safety and metabolism tasks
ranked.summary: Standardized benchmarks and knowledge graphs now test whether predictive models generalize across drug safety, metabolism and resistance tasks.

ranked.headline: Comparative genomics dissects transposon and satellite repeat evolution across genomes
ranked.summary: Comparative analyses now resolve insertion ages, horizontal transfer routes and repeat architecture in plant and fungal genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational profiling of cancer genome evolution, mutation signatures and function
ranked.summary: Single-cell and pan-cancer whole-genome datasets now allow oncogene amplification, mutational signatures and mutation function to be resolved at scale.

ranked.headline: Physics-grounded generative models steer biomolecular structure and dynamics sampling
ranked.summary: Diffusion models now generate all-atom MD trajectories and cryo-EM and cryo-ET structures under explicit physical or experimental constraints.

ranked.headline: Web Resources Address siRNA Toxicity, Peptide Delivery Data, and sncRNA Fragments
ranked.summary: Accessible web servers and a standalone tool now cover siRNA toxicity prediction, peptide delivery curation, and short RNA fragment analysis.

ranked.headline: Compressed-space alignment and experimental restraints guide structural data analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply PCA compression, molecular dynamics-derived segmentation, and ion mobility restraints to structural analysis tasks.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer biological state and bias from noisy multi-omics readouts
ranked.summary: Benchmarks and tools now test whether omics inferences survive sample-processing artifacts, longitudinal design, and real-world confounders.

ranked.headline: Predicting dynamic cell states from single-cell snapshots and unseen perturbations
ranked.summary: Foundation models and consensus-based frameworks now forecast single-cell expression dynamics and unseen perturbation responses from scRNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: LLM agents ground biological analysis in raw data, tools, and knowledge bases
ranked.summary: Preprints now couple LLM reasoning to scRNA-seq, proteomics, and rare disease knowledge bases, benchmarked against established tools.
